QNLI/SST2 rows only after MNLI gate
same-artifact task quality and CPU runtime proof
claim_rules.safe_headline: Blind ternary PTQ fails for tested dense Qwen; row-scale ternary students require matching CPU runtime semantics; BitDistill-style recovery is still under gate.

decision_gates.decision_rule: Wait for the active 655.36M Stage-2 producer, downstream MNLI, and postprocess reports.
decision_gates.failure_condition: Saturation far below FP, requiring recipe/loss audit instead of broader sweeps.
decision_gates.success_condition: Meaningful marginal gain or within-1pt FP recovery gate.

decision_gates.decision_rule: If gamma-60 rebalances attention/CE updates, run matched downstream MNLI.
decision_gates.failure_condition: Attention remains dominant, indicating deeper loss-normalization or recipe mismatch.
decision_gates.success_condition: Attention-KD gradient no longer dominates CE by the current local threshold.

decision_gates.decision_rule: Choose packed classifier runtime or causal prompt-scoring product surface after MNLI recovery.
decision_gates.failure_condition: Quality proof remains PyTorch-only while runtime proof remains causal-only.
decision_gates.gate: Same-artifact task quality plus CPU runtime
decision_gates.success_condition: One artifact provides task quality, agreement, RSS, file size, and throughput.

executive_verdict: The work is publishable as a rigorous boundary study and systems-contract prototype, not as a universal BitNet converter and not yet as a complete BitDistill reproduction.

paper_outline.content: Extreme ternary retrofit is a representation-learning and runtime-contract problem, not a file conversion problem.
Blind PTQ collapses: FP PPL 13.901475, PTQ PPL 3813121.803327, FP mean 0.644169, PTQ mean 0.348671.
Row-scale QAT recovers +0.150788 over PTQ but remains -0.144710 below FP on the current ten-task mean.
One-scale TL2 relative RMS error 1.904230; exact row-scale error 0.000197.
I2_SR file 1211.3 MiB, PPL 38.8477, decode 19.07 tok/s; native classifier MNLI 0.652165 is not product-ready.

product_mvp.input: A Hugging Face model, task/eval dataset, and target CPU/runtime profile.
product_mvp.name: CPU-first ternary retrofit evaluator
product_mvp.output: Pass/fail evidence bundle plus suggested path: reject PTQ, try BitDistill/QAT, use row-scale I2_SR, or stop.
product_mvp.target_user: Engineers deciding whether a model-task pair is worth ternary distillation and CPU deployment.
product_mvp.value: It prevents false converter claims by producing a fail-closed decision report: quality delta, paired confidence intervals, PPL, file size, RSS, prompt/decode speed, runtime compatibility, and claim label.
product_mvp.why_useful_now: The negative PTQ and row-scale runtime findings are already actionable even when the answer is no.

publishable_units.claim: Blind FP/BF16-to-ternary projection is not viable for the tested dense-Qwen setup.
publishable_units.evidence: FP WikiText PPL 13.901475; naive PTQ PPL 3,813,121.803327; FP ten-task mean 0.644169; PTQ mean 0.348671
publishable_units.risk: Scope must remain tested dense Qwen; do not universalize to every architecture.

publishable_units.claim: Row scales are learned model semantics and must be preserved by CPU formats.
publishable_units.evidence: one-scale TL2 RMS error 1.904230; exact row-scale RMS error 0.000197
publishable_units.risk: This supports I2_SR/row-scale contracts, not TL2 row-scale support.

publishable_units.claim: A compatible row-scale ternary causal artifact can run through packed CPU I2_SR.
publishable_units.evidence: I2_SR file 1211.3 MiB, PPL 38.8477, prompt 211.67 tok/s, decode 19.07 tok/s; Q4_K_M file 940.4 MiB, PPL 12.8112
publishable_units.risk: Do not claim Q4-quality or Q4-storage competitiveness.

publishable_units.claim: Local BitDistill-style training is improving but has not reproduced paper-level GLUE quality.
publishable_units.risk: Must frame as a reproduction-gap study until a within-1pt row is reproduced.

publishable_units.claim: Native packed sequence classification is not product-ready yet.
publishable_units.evidence: MNLI 0.652165; PyTorch agreement 0.976668; sequence-isolated 7.456204 ex/s; token-id runner 2.724140 ex/s
publishable_units.risk: Agreement and quality are below gate; useful only as a research demo.

publishable_units.claim: MoE/Kimi support is not proven beyond tiny Qwen2MoE plumbing.
publishable_units.evidence: local Kimi artifacts 0; MoE product gates passed 6/9
publishable_units.risk: No real Kimi artifact, quality benchmark, or routed expert locality proof exists.
